dedupe_keys.name: coastal and marine data centre of the belize coastal zone management authority and institute czmai

description: The Coastal and Marine Data Centre of Belize's Coastal Zone Management Authority and Institute (CZMAI) holds geographic data used to inform coastal resource management. The page read on 2026-09-28 lists shapefiles that can be downloaded or requested: human use layers from the 2010 zoning schemes (coastal development, conservation, marine transportation, fishing, marine recreation, agriculture and coastal planning regions, the last downloadable) and a 3 km zone of influence; marine habitat cover of coral, seagrass and mangroves for 2007 to 2010; species distributions (manatee sightings 2012, turtles, dolphins and crocodiles 2010); and transportation layers of shipping ports and shipping lanes from 2005, both downloadable. Coverage is Belize's coast and barrier reef lagoon. Access is free, partly by request; no licence is stated. Caveats: layers are old (2005 to 2012) and the page says updates are coming. It supports coastal hazard exposure and nature-based protection studies, for example mangrove and reef cover in front of ports and settlements under storm surge. No related Belize coastal record is catalogued; the NEMO Belize disaster database complements it.
